prompt: Asked to write frontend test cases for Defect Management; tests/Elijah/test-cases.md was empty.
output: Found tests/Elijah/placeholder.test.js was misleadingly named - it already contained real, passing defectHelpers tests, not an actual placeholder (unlike Lucio's and Ryan's, which were genuinely empty). Read Aeric's test-cases.md and test files as the format/depth to match, then proposed: renaming placeholder.test.js to defectHelpers.test.js; adding defectCsvColumns.test.js (mirrors Aeric's CSV column test - field mapping, date formatting, fallback-to-empty-string); adding DefectFormDialog.test.jsx (create vs edit title, no-Status-field-on-create, required-field validation blocking submit, pre-filled values in edit mode); and a test-cases.md documenting 13 automated cases plus 12 manual/exploratory checks.
action-detail: Applied the rename and both new test files. Mocked liftApi.fetchLifts in the component test so the embedded LiftSelect's real network call didn't spam jsdom XHR errors into the test output. Deliberately left 'pick a Severity value and successfully submit' as a manual check rather than an automated one - MUI's Select needs a mouseDown-then-click-option interaction in jsdom that's easy to make brittle, and Aeric made the same call for their own Schedule form dialog, so kept that as manual check #14 in test-cases.md instead of forcing it. Verified: npm run test:elijah, 13/13 passing.
